label: Set a stat string
aiHint: Sets a string SimGame stat. Use this when a conversation choice should store a durable id, route, clue, system, faction, or setup value that later conversations may read, or that contracts/missions may read in mod setups that support runtime stat access.

inputs.label: Stat Key
inputs.aiHint: Use a stable stat key for the durable state being recorded.

inputs.label: Stat Value
inputs.aiHint: Use a literal string for fixed values, or an operation when copying a dynamic value such as a system id, contract id, tag-derived value, or another stat.
